implementation: Explicit revocation, not retained backing after unlink

identity.handle: Existing local generation; exhausted slots retire
identity.backend: Short directory-entry (LBA, offset) under exclusive adapter borrow; not a public inode or lifetime identifier
identity.authentication: Every data read/write/truncate/fstat rechecks the entry location then obtains fresh cluster and size; pathname is a locator, not sufficient authority

ownership.fd: FdTable stores packed VFS handle plus shared description index
ownership.description: OpenDescription refs share offset/status; last take marks release_backend
ownership.vfs: Mount open_handles and backend slots remain owned for revoked handles until close
ownership.backend: Raw FAT directory entries and cluster chains; no open-object refcount
ownership.unlink: Revoke all matching entry aliases before first disk mutation, then immediate raw deletion
ownership.rename: Revoke destination; successful source handles rebind by authenticated source location, independent of input alias spelling
ownership.directory_rename: Conservatively revoke every other FAT handle; full descendant retention not implemented
ownership.truncate: Fresh lookup on every operation prevents another descriptor using freed old cluster or stale size
ownership.close: Generation-only check accepts revoked/poisoned slots exactly once; close does not free the raw chain
ownership.mount: Existing Busy admission until all handles close; poisoned sync_dir fails, keeping mount/cache installed
ownership.failure: Any mutating backend error poisons mounted adapter. Close remains possible; no recovery or exactly-once backing-reclamation claim

limits: Failure recovery and raw FAT transactional ownership remain incomplete
Exclusive volume ownership required; external/raw parallel mutation not supported
